gauge.name: Little Wekiva River near ALTAMONTE SPRINGS 2N

impacts.statement: Major flooding in the Spring Oaks neighborhood, with rescues likely necessary. Roads impassible and several inches of water in some homes.

Moderate flooding between State Road 434 and State Road 436, with water covering roads and entering low lying homes near the river. Flooding also occurring in the Clemson Drive and Lake Brantley areas.
Minor flooding near the river in the Altamonte Springs area.
River becomes bankfull near Altamonte Springs and may begin to encroach some low lying yards along the river.
